tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam rim zab mo rgyud la skye bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i yi ge 'phrin las mkha' khyab bzhugs// na mo gu ru budha dhwa dza ye/ bla ma yi dam rang sems dbyer med pa'i/ /gdod ma'i gnas lugs dpa' bo rdo rje chos/ /rang ngo shes pa'i ngang nas gsol 'debs kyis/ /bsam don 'di rnams yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi/ /ba dan dkar pos bskyod pa'i las 'bras kyi/ /blang dor mthun pa'i rlung gis rab bskul nas/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar mdzod/ /skyabs gsum gser gyi cod pan spyi bor bcings/ /byang chub sems gnyis nor bu'i do shal mdzes/ /rdor sems bdud rtsis nyes ltung dri ma bkrus/ /bslu med bla ma'i byin brlabs 'jug par mdzod/ /yid 'ong rgyal yum phyi yi rnal 'byor ma/ /bam̐ yig nang gi rdo rje btsun mo'i mchog /sems nyid stong gsal gsang ba'i mkha' spyod yum/ /rang zhal mthong ba'i rtse dgas rol bar mdzod/ /snod kyi 'jig rten e yig gzhal med khang / /bcud kyi sems can bam̐ yig rnal 'byor ma/ /zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /cir snang dag pa'i snang bar 'char bar mdzod/ /de ltar bskyed rim gsal bas pho nya mchog /rigs ldan mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab 'dus/ /dbu mar rlung zhugs gnyis med ye shes 'bar/ /ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs chen 'byed par mdzod/ /sgyu ma mkhan po 'khrul 'khor gnad la mkhas/ /gdol pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa dang / /shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa ltar/ /kun kyang lus kyi gnad la mkhas par mdzod/ /rtog bcas sems dang zag bcas lus bskyed pa/ /rtsa gnas so sor zhugs pa'i rlung sems rnams/ /dbu mar thim pas mi rtog chos sku dang / /zag med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob mdzod/ /thun chen drug pa thun chung sum cu po/ /re re re re 'phel ba goms pa'i mthus/

/rlung sbyor rgyal po dpal ldan kumbha kas/ /las rlung ma lus dbu mar zhugs par mdzod/ /lte ba'i padmor rlung lnga'i ti la kar/ /rtse gcig bsgom pa'i kha sbyor rnal 'byor gyis/ /lus sems rtsa la dri bzhon zhugs pa yi/ /bde ba mchog gis bdag rgyud tshim par mdzod/ /lus sems rtsa la rlung rnams rim zhugs pa/ /de tshe tshor bde mi rtog bde ba dang / /mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes legs skyes nas/ /gsal la rdzogs pa'i rtags bcu 'char bar mdzod/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i las kyi gtum mo dang / /bde chen 'khor lo'i 'od kyi gtum mo gnyis/ /chos kyi 'khor lor ro mnyam 'dres pa yi/ /bde drod ye shes lhag par 'bar bar mdzod/ /rdo rje btsun mo nyi ma 'bum gyi gzis/ /'od gzugs gangs ri'i dbang po zhus pa las/ /a wa dhu tir 'bar 'dzag rnam rol bas/ /bde stong mchog gi dpal la rol bar mdzod/ /ches zab rnal 'byor bcu gcig la 'bad pas/ /nam zhig dus na dga' ma byu ru'i mdog /li khri'i skra grol dmar ser mig g.yo bas/ /mngon sum rig 'dzin grong du 'khrid par mdzod/ /sindhur laṅka li yi sdong por bcas/ /ro ldan gnas su bsgrub zhing yul kun tu/ /myul bas gang gi mdzod spur 'khyil ris can/ /'phos pa'i mdzes mas mkha' spyod 'khrid par mdzod/ /nang gi phag mos gzung 'dzin 'khril shing bcom/ /mchog gi dhu tir zhugs pa'i gar mkhan ma/ /tshangs pa'i sgo nas sprin lam dbyings su 'thon/ /khrag 'thung dpa' bor 'khyud cing rol bar mdzod/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis/ /stong gsal brjod du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang / /zung 'jug blo 'das rang sems rnal 'byor ma/ /rang ngo shes nas rtag tu skyong bar mdzod/ rtsa rlung thig le e bam̐ dbyings su thim/ /sems nyid bde chen chos sku'i dpal thob nas/ /bgrangs yas gzugs sku'i rnam rol dpag med kyis/ /'gro kun mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par mdzod/

/ces pa 'di yang bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo'i rnal 'byor pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gi kha don du dpal sa skya'i mkha' spyod dpal gyi pho brang du bris pa 'dis 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam rim zab mo rgyud la skye bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i yi ge PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
